introduction: South Dakota calls unemployment insurance Reemployment Assistance. Apply through the RA Benefits Portal or the Claims Call Center, then request payments weekly.
description: South Dakota calls unemployment insurance Reemployment Assistance. Apply through the RA Benefits Portal or the Claims Call Center, then request payments weekly.

sections.who: DLR assesses covered earnings, job loss and ongoing ability and availability for full-time work. It describes the benefit as employment insurance rather than financial-need assistance.
sections.get: Eligible claimed weeks receive temporary payments after the waiting week.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. File the initial claim

    Use the portal link or call 605-626-3179 during published weekday hours.

  2. Monitor correspondence

    Complete assigned verification and work-registration steps.

  3. Request each week

    Use the portal or automated 605-626-3212 route after the week ends.
sections.after: Keep filing eligible weeks while awaiting a decision or appeal. Save the request confirmation and report gross earnings accurately.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Initial claim and eligibility overview, Weekly payment requests. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Should I wait for approval before weekly filing?
No. DLR says to file weekly requests while eligibility is pending or a denial is being appealed.
How do I know a weekly request was filed?
The state says a request without confirmation has not been filed.
Is the first eligible week paid?
The first eligible weekly request is the unpaid waiting week.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
